annotationRationale: The favorable outcomes are counted by exhaustive disjoint cases, sequential choices, and choosing three dice without order. Equally likely outcomes identify this count as the numerator.
sourceMethod: Followed the first official method, counting the three face-value patterns. Added the three-extra-points observation to justify exhaustiveness and explained why the counts have no duplicates.

review.mathCheck: Relative to seven ones, the three extra points have exactly the patterns 3, 2+1, or 1+1+1. These yield \(7\), \(7\cdot6=42\), and \(\binom73=35\) labeled outcomes. All faces are legal, the cases are disjoint, and \(n=84\), choice E.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of the first MAA solution #11, printed p. 4. The extra-points argument justifies the official three-pattern enumeration; the unused stars-and-bars alternative is unnecessary.
review.annotationCheck: The key and denominator are correct. The candidate explains labeled outcomes, exhaustiveness, nonoverlap, and equal likelihood at an appropriate AMC 10 level.
